templates.projectReadme:
# {{modName}}

Minecraft {{mcVersion}} / NeoForge {{loaderVersion}} mod, generated by mcmodkit from a ModSpec.

## Build

```
gradlew.bat build      # Windows
./gradlew build        # macOS / Linux
```

The mod jar is written to build/libs/. Requires JDK {{javaVersion}}; the first build downloads NeoForge and Minecraft (several hundred MB).

## Run

`gradlew.bat runClient` / `runServer` start a development client/server with the mod loaded.

{{TEXTURE_NOTES}}

## Iterate

Edit the ModSpec JSON and regenerate: mcmodkit overwrites the files it manages and never touches your own files.

notes: Registration uses DeferredRegister + DeferredHolder on the mod event bus (NeoForge), unlike Fabric's direct Registry.register.
Mappings are Mojang official (ModDevGradle default): no mappings dependency to pin.
Datapack directories are singular since 1.21: data/<ns>/loot_table/... and data/minecraft/tags/block/...
Textures are not generated: add 16x16 PNGs under assets/<ns>/textures/{item,block}/<id>.png.

maven.neoforged.net is unreachable on some networks (TLS reset). settings.gradle resolves plugins from the ForgeCDN mirror (neoforged.forgecdn.net) and synthesizes a local net.neoforged:minecraft-dependencies:<mc> POM from Mojang's version manifest, cached under .gradle/mcdeps-repo. The main host is deliberately absent: Gradle hard-fails on an unreachable repository instead of falling through.
Requires JDK 21. First build downloads NeoForge + Minecraft (several hundred MB).

Compile + runtime verified on the authoring machine: gradle build passes and a dedicated server boots with the mod loaded (scripts/verify-runtime.mjs, PASS). 1.21.2+ requires a registry id on every registered item and block: the templates call Item.Properties#setId / BlockBehaviour.Properties#setId with a ResourceKey, otherwise the game throws "Item id not set"/"Block id not set" at load time - caught by runtime verification, not compilation.
Item construction goes through ITEMS.register(name, supplier) so the spec can pick an item class (itemBehaviors). registerSimpleItem cannot express a custom class.
Derived from neoforge-1.21.1, re-fitted with facts from scripts/version-facts.mjs (loader 21.4.157, pack_format 46 read from the real game jar).

SCOPE: items + blocks + textures + UI (Screen). Recipes/advancements/entities/datagen are deliberately absent because their templates are not version-independent. Asking for them fails with a clear error rather than emitting broken Java.

UI (Screen) ported from fabric-1.21.1 for the Screen class and from neoforge-1.21.1 for the client bootstrap; javap on this version's mapped jar confirmed renderBackground(GuiGraphics,int,int,float), mouseScrolled(x,y,scrollX,scrollY), Button.Builder.bounds, Font.split/width and GuiEventListener input defaults. Entity renderer wiring was omitted because this adapter has no entities slice.
